answer: A place I go to be completely alone is a quiet stretch of the riverbank a short walk from my home. I tend to go there whenever I feel overwhelmed and need to clear my head. It is a [[secluded]] spot that few people seem to know about, which is exactly why I love it. I usually just sit on the grass, watch the water and let my thoughts settle. There is something deeply [[restorative]] about being alone in nature, with no phone buzzing and no one demanding my attention. I find that a bit of [[solitude]] helps me process my feelings and make sense of whatever is bothering me. Far from feeling lonely, I feel more like myself there than almost anywhere else. Honestly, in a world that never seems to stop, having a private place to simply be is genuinely [[precious]]. I always return home feeling calmer and more centred.

title: Describe a famous place in your country
bullets: and whether you would recommend it
answer: A famous place in my country that I think everyone should see is the National Martyrs' Memorial, which honours those who died in our war of independence. It is a deeply [[poignant]] and symbolic site, and it holds enormous significance for the nation. The memorial itself is architecturally striking, with a series of triangular structures rising towards the sky. Visiting it is a genuinely [[moving]] experience, as it commemorates such an important chapter of our history. What makes it so meaningful is that it represents the sacrifice and courage of ordinary people. I think it is important for younger generations to visit and understand their [[heritage]]. The surrounding grounds are peaceful and beautifully maintained, which adds to the solemn atmosphere. Honestly, I would recommend it to any visitor, because it offers real insight into what shaped our country. It is a place that inspires both reflection and a quiet sense of [[patriotism]].

title: Describe a place you enjoyed visiting as a child
answer: A place I absolutely loved visiting as a child was my grandparents' village home, where we would spend our holidays. I went there every year with my family, and those visits are among my happiest childhood memories. The house was surrounded by open fields and ponds, which felt like an [[endless]] playground to a small child. I would spend whole days climbing trees, catching fish and running around barefoot with my cousins. Everything felt wonderfully [[carefree]], far from the rules and routines of city life. What made it so special was the sense of freedom and the warmth of the whole extended family gathered together. The pace of life there was so gentle and [[unhurried]]. Honestly, looking back, those visits filled me with a deep sense of [[belonging]] that I still treasure. Sadly, the village has changed a lot since then, but the memories remain vivid and precious to me.

title: Describe a sports venue or stadium you have visited
bullets: and how you felt about it
answer: A sports venue I visited that left a strong impression on me was our national cricket stadium, where I watched an international match. Cricket is almost a religion in my country, so the atmosphere was electric long before the game even started. The stadium was absolutely [[packed]], with tens of thousands of fans singing and waving flags. When our team scored, the roar of the crowd was genuinely [[thunderous]], and I could feel the energy in my chest. What made it so memorable was the incredible sense of [[unity]]; complete strangers were celebrating together as one. Watching a match on television simply cannot compare to being there in person. The whole experience was thrilling and completely [[immersive]]. Honestly, by the end I had lost my voice from cheering, but I did not care in the slightest. It was one of the most exciting days of my life, and I would jump at the chance to go again.

title: Describe a place you would like to visit again
bullets: and why you want to return
answer: A place I would love to visit again is a small mountain town I went to a few years ago, which completely charmed me. I only stayed a few days, which was nowhere near long enough to appreciate it fully. The town was wonderfully [[picturesque]], with cobbled streets, old stone houses and stunning views in every direction. I hope to make it happen soon.

title: Describe a peaceful place you know
answer: A place I associate with real peace is an old, quiet mosque near my grandparents' home, which I have known since childhood. It is not grand or famous, but it has a wonderfully [[tranquil]] atmosphere that I have never found elsewhere. Whenever I visit, I am struck by the deep sense of calm the moment I step inside. Honestly, I always leave feeling lighter and more [[centred]]. I think everyone needs a place like this, somewhere they can retreat to and simply be still for a while.

title: Describe a hotel you have stayed in
bullets: and how you felt about it
answer: A hotel that genuinely exceeded my expectations was a resort I stayed at during a family holiday by the sea. title: Describe a place with clean and fresh air
bullets: and why the air was so pleasant
answer: A place I associate with wonderfully clean air is a tea estate in the hills that I visited a couple of years ago. Coming from a polluted city, the difference in air quality was immediately noticeable and genuinely [[refreshing]]. The moment I stepped off the bus, I could not stop taking deep breaths of the cool, [[crisp]] mountain air. It felt as though my lungs were being cleaned out after years of city smog. I came away not only feeling healthier but also more conscious of environmental issues. It is a place I would return to just to breathe properly again.

title: Describe a museum or art gallery you have visited
bullets: and how you felt about it
answer: A museum I found genuinely fascinating was the national museum in the capital, which I visited on a school trip years ago and again more recently. It houses an impressive collection spanning our country's history, from ancient artefacts to modern art. title: Describe a place that is important to your family
bullets: and how you feel about it
answer: A place that holds deep importance for my family is our ancestral home in the village, which has been in the family for generations. title: Describe a place with interesting architecture
bullets: and why you find it interesting
answer: A place with genuinely interesting architecture that comes to mind is an old palace I visited in the heart of the old city. title: Describe a village or countryside area you have visited
bullets: and how you felt about it
answer: A countryside area I visited that I still think about fondly is a small farming village a few hours from the city. title: Describe a place where you like to walk
bullets: and why you like walking there
answer: A place I love to walk is a tree-lined avenue in a large park near my home. I try to go there most evenings, either alone or occasionally with a friend. title: Describe your ideal home

answer: If I could design my ideal home, it would be a comfortable house on the edge of a quiet town, balancing modern convenience with a connection to nature. answer: One of the hardest decisions I have faced was turning down a stable job to pursue something more uncertain but closer to what I actually wanted. title: Describe a time you helped someone

title: Describe a time you learned a new skill

answer: A skill I taught myself relatively recently was cooking, which I had always avoided out of sheer laziness. title: Describe a memorable journey you have taken

title: Describe a time you were late for something

title: Describe a time you solved a difficult problem

title: Describe an achievement you are proud of

title: Describe a time you tried something for the first time

title: Describe a time you felt nervous

title: Describe a time you worked as part of a team

title: Describe a time you complained about something

title: Describe a time you helped a stranger

title: Describe a time you got lost somewhere

title: Describe a time you had a disagreement with someone
